Construct Name: Belief in true and false political statements (64 study-authored statements across four UK political topics)
Context Text: 2,858 UK adults eligible to vote, two randomised trials run around the 2024 general election (studies 2 and 3 of the paper); each participant researched two of four political topics using an AI chatbot or Google search and rated all 64 statements before and after.
Notes: resp is stored agree-first: 1 = agree, 7 = disagree.

Construct Name: Trust in eight sources of information about UK politics and current affairs
Context Text: 2,499 UK adults eligible to vote, nationally representative survey fielded around the 2024 general election (study 1 of the paper).
Notes: 1 = trust a great deal to 4 = do not trust at all; the source's fifth option, "Don't know", is dropped.
